title: boehmeria platyphylla var. sumatrana
intro: Boehmeria platyphylla var. sumatrana, commonly known as Sumatran Boehmeria, is a plant species belonging to the nettle family (Urticaceae). This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, making it useful in treating various health conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and wounds. The therapeutic actions of Boehmeria platyphylla var. sumatrana include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antipyretic properties, which contribute to its traditional use in folk medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
